resources.string: Wear it virtually before you buy
Your photo + the product = your new look

Upload or take a clear photo, then paste a clothing product link or upload the garment image. The app sends both references to the configured AI API and generates a realistic image of you wearing the item.
Use a clear front-facing or three-quarter photo. The more visible your body and clothing area are, the more consistent the result can be.
Paste a product URL from any store. If the store blocks image extraction, upload the product image manually.
Add at least one garment. You can combine a top, bottom, outerwear, shoes and an accessory.
This is used only when you convert the generated try-on image into a video.
Your person and garment references are being processed by the configured OpenRouter image model.
The generated image uses your photo as the identity/body reference and the garment image as the clothing reference.

Nothing is sent to the AI when you only select photos or paste a link. When you press Generate, the selected person and garment references are sent to the configured OpenRouter API to create the result.

The result is a high-fidelity visual simulation, not a physical millimeter-accurate sizing measurement. Exact real-world fit still depends on garment measurements, fabric stretch and your body measurements.
